topic_intro: 내 삶을 이야기하는 말투가 만드는 감정
sentence: You are the narrator of your own life. The tone and perspective with which you describe each experience generates feelings associated with that narration. For example, if you find yourself constantly assuming, "This is hard," "I wonder whether I'm going to survive," or "It looks like this is going to turn out badly," you'll generate anxious feelings. It's time to restructure the way you think. Underlying this narration are the beliefs that frame your experience and give it meaning. Think of your beliefs as having many layers.
